description: EMT benchmark for the VSC's average-value model and its controls: a rectifier holding its DC link at 800 V, fed from a 400 V grid, through a DC load step. simscape_emt_vsc_benchmark.m builds it in Simscape, with the controller in a MATLAB Function block, and tests/test_emt_converters.py builds it with Electrisim's solver and controller, both from this file. Both start in its steady state, which tests/test_emt_converters.py computes and writes into 'start'. SI units; phasors are amplitudes, phase a = cos(w t + angle).

grid.description: A three-phase source, star-grounded, behind R_g and L_g, L_g damped by R_p across it.

vsc.description: Averaged phase voltages, star-grounded, behind its reactor r, l onto the filter capacitors c_f at its AC bus. Rated s_rated, its current limited to i_limit_pu. Its DC link c_link at v_dc; its DC load behind r_dc, l_dc.

load.description: A resistor r_load on its DC side; a second, r_step, switched in parallel at t_step: 50 % more power.

switching.description: The same VSC as a switching model: a two-level bridge, each leg's switches to the DC link's poles (the negative pole the reference), by regular-sampled PWM at f_sw - a triangular carrier rising from its valley at t = 0, the controller sampling at each peak and valley, its voltages and DC load current averaged since its last sample. The grid's and filter capacitors' star point floats, held by r_bias to the reference. Electrisim steps dt; the waveforms are compared every dt_out.
